description: The bar chart illustrates the Accuracy (%) of various model configurations across two distinct datasets, separated into two main panels by a vertical dashed line, with the right panel explicitly titled "PolitiFact" and the left panel's title obscured by a grey box. The horizontal axis displays the categorical configurations, which are ordered identically in both panels: "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition", with the labels rotated diagonally for readability. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy (%)", featuring a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 75.0 to 95.0 at regular intervals of 2.5. Within each of the two dataset panels, the bars are grouped side-by-side and color-coded by configuration: "Ours" is dark red, "w/o comments" is orange, "w/o text" is light yellow, "w/o select" is light blue, "w/o emotion" is medium blue, and "w/o cognition" is dark blue. Every bar is outlined in black and annotated with its exact value in bold text directly above it. In the left panel, the values are 89.84 for "Ours", 86.82 for "w/o comments", 80.10 for "w/o text" (the shortest bar in this group), 88.80 for "w/o select", 87.34 for "w/o emotion", and 87.17 for "w/o cognition". In the right "PolitiFact" panel, the values are 90.57 for "Ours" (the tallest bar overall), 85.85 for "w/o comments", 83.02 for "w/o text", 89.62 for "w/o select", 84.91 for "w/o emotion", and 87.74 for "w/o cognition". The bars are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order by value, but rather follow a consistent categorical sequence in both panels, and visual emphasis is provided by the bold numerical annotations and a light grey background with dashed horizontal grid lines.
